desc:
🎥 Welcome to Escape The Cinema Obby!

Step into a world of adventure like you've never seen before! Get ready for a wild ride as you make your way through a world of exciting movie-inspired obstacles. Dodge flying popcorn, leap over soda and conquer action-packed challenges that make it hard to tell what's real and what's not. Can you make it to the final scene and escape the cinema?

🏆 Completed the Obby? Hit ‘UP’ to FOLLOW and LIKE the game to stay updated on new stages and exciting updates!

🌟 Key Features:
🎬 Over 30 movie-themed Stages!
🕹️ Auto-save items so you never lose progress.
🚨 Frequent updates with new challenges & surprises!
🎁 Follow the game & creators to unlock special perks!
🍿 Group Bonus: Join our group for a free speed coil!

🎥 Ready to take the stage? Hit ‘Play’ now and jump into the action!

TAGS: Obby, Adventure, Movies, Parkour, Platformer, Fun, Escape, Challenge
